Access 20+ metrics (sleep stages, Body Battery, HRV, VO2 max, training readiness, body composition, SPO2), download FIT/GPX files for route analysis, query elevation/pace at any point, and generate interactive health dashboards. From casual "show me this week's workouts" to deep "analyze my recovery vs training load".
skills.description_zh: 自然对话查询 Garmin 数据——如“我滑雪最快速度是多少？”、“昨晚睡得如何？”、“下午3点心率多少？”。访问睡眠分期、身体电量、HRV、最大摄氧量、训练准备程度、身体成分、血氧饱和度等20多项指标，下载 FIT/GPX 文件分析路线，查询任意点的海拔或配速，生成交互式健康仪表盘。从随意的“展示本周运动”到深度的“分析我的恢复与训练负荷对比”，应有尽有。
skills.name: Garmin Health Analysis
